{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts undershoot prices during upticks, especially with positive sentiment, creating persistent buy opportunity bias",
    "When prices are flat or declining, model over-projects declines by 1-2 points, showing lag on the downside",
    "Positive sentiment (score > 0.5) aligns model forecasts upward but still lags true price momentum by 2-3 days",
    "Mean reversion bias: model avoids extremes too aggressively, missing 10-15% price continuations",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to negative isn't captured quickly enough - 1-2 day forecast lag exists",
    "When sentiment is strongly negative (-0.33), model remains too optimistic by 1-2 points",
    "Price levels below 70 trigger more conservative forecasts than the model uses, creating 0.5-1 point undershoot"
] }
